notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and federate configuration. A monitor subscribes to HLAserviceReporting, directly requests its standard-MIM value, and verifies the conditional reliable reflection after the subject changes and restores its public Service Reporting switch. The monitor does not subscribe to HLAreportServiceInvocation, and the scenario does not depend on provider-specific headers, names, registries, or internal APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation lifecycle, standard-MIM object-class subscription and attribute-value requests, Service Reporting switch getter/setter, and FederateAmbassador reflection callback
